transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get the pre-offer huddle started for the comedy benefit guest segment. We've got a fifteen-minute slot at 7:40 PM on Saturday evening that needs to wrap before the 8:00 PM news break. The two finalists are Lio Hart and Mara Vale, with Mara Vale currently holding the larger public profile. Before I make the booking call, I need to hear from each of you: artist relations, broadcast engineering, clearance, and sponsor integration — please report your latest findings so we can move forward.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to update everyone on the artist availability situation. I confirmed with both agents this afternoon that Mara Vale's hold has been released and she cannot appear on Saturday. Meanwhile, Lio Hart is available only from 7:40 PM to 7:55 PM. I haven't been able to update the booking grid yet because it was locked for payroll review when the confirmations came in.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding from my transmission test this morning. A remote duet feed would create an unacceptable five-second return-path delay — that's a dealbreaker for live broadcast. However, Lio Hart can perform a live in-studio solo through the tested local audio path with no issues. I haven't entered the result in the technical packet yet because it's still awaiting the final camera map, but the test itself is conclusive.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a clearance issue before we proceed. My rights search confirmed that the routine Lio Hart proposed, which uses the song 'Midnight Parade,' cannot be cleared for the broadcast. The approved replacement is the spoken-word routine 'Open Tabs,' with the on-air credit 'Written and performed by Lio Hart.' I haven't circulated the clearance note yet because the rights database export is still being attached to the file, but the clearance determination itself is final.
transcript.speaker: A4
